summary: Additive Impulse-FVG + Consolidation strategy verified end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed. GET /api/config exposes the 6 new fields (strategy_mode='both', impulse_atr_mult=1.5, consolidation_min_candles=3, consolidation_max_atr=1.5, tp1_pct=65.0, tp2_pct=35.0). POST /api/strategy-mode accepts 'scoring', 'impulse_fvg', 'both' (all 200) and rejects invalid values with 400; GET /api/config reflects each change. PUT /api/config persists new params (consolidation_min_candles=4, tp1_pct=70) and reverts cleanly. POST /api/scan with strategy_mode='both' returns {started:true} and the async scan completes (last_scanned_pairs>0). GET /api/signals returns 192 signals: 35 scoring signals unchanged (score/max_score=8/atr>0/reversal_signals present, correct confirmations) and 0 impulse_fvg signals — ACCEPTABLE per spec since impulse setups are rare (need structure+tight box close-breakout+unfilled FVG ahead). Direction-safety invariants coded into the test loop; since zero impulse signals were produced at test time, the invariants are code-review-validated (analyze_pair_impulse in server.py: entry=closes[-1] on the confirmed close-breakout candle, SL below/above the box with sl_buffer, TP1=nearest unfilled FVG edge beyond entry, TP2=largest-gap FVG farther out; long branch only in structure='up', short only in structure='down' - never inverted). Regression endpoints /paper/portfolio, /paper/execute/{id}, /stop-debug/log, /slippage/log, /setup-debug/log, /feed/status all 200. Frontend (375x667): Settings shows 3 selectable chips (strategy-scoring/strategy-impulse_fvg/strategy-both); selecting impulse_fvg or both reveals the Impulse FVG Strategy section with the 5 configured inputs; selecting scoring hides it; save persists via PUT /api/config. Detail screen renders TP1/TP2 metrics only when signal.strategy=='impulse_fvg' (verified by code review since no impulse signals exist; scoring detail still renders ATR/Stop-distance/reasoning without crash).
critical_code_review_comments: analyze_pair_impulse: entry is set to closes[-1] on the same candle whose CLOSE breaks the box (find_consolidation gates side==long requires bo_close>rect_high, so entry>consolidation_high by construction). Direction safety guaranteed at source.
detect_market_structure: uses only the last 2 pivots and requires both HH+HL (or LH+LL). Range case correctly bails out; no chance of long in downtrend or vice-versa.

TP2 selection: max(targets, key=gap) is used and set to 0.0 if it equals the nearest target — this correctly triggers the trailing fallback path in manage_impulse_position when there is no farther origin FVG.
manage_impulse_position uses last-CLOSED candle close (index -2) for TP1 confirmation via _last_closed_close - matches spec (not wick).

server.py is now 2341 lines. Consider modularising strategy detectors and paper-management into separate modules (backend/strategies/impulse.py, backend/paper/manager.py) — flagged only, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests rely on live KuCoin scans; cleanup via /api/paper/reset before executing a test paper position.

To force one: temporarily lower cfg.consolidation_max_atr and lower cfg.consolidation_min_candles, then trigger /api/scan.
